description: Markdown to HTML with GitHub-flavoured tables and strikethrough, heading ids, the list of headings and links, and a word count. Raw HTML in the input is escaped unless allowHtml is true; links and images with javascript:, vbscript: or data: addresses are removed. Pure code, no outbound request. Input up to 200 KB. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

allowHtml.description: Keep raw HTML from the input, default false (escaped)

headingIds.description: Give each heading an id, default true

markdown.description: The Markdown text, up to 200 KB
